# Laya Meeting Actions

Turns meeting notes or a Teams transcript into a short summary, the decisions made, a clear action list (what, who, by when), open questions and a ready-to-send follow-up email. Can prepare the actions for your Action Tracker.

**Who can use it:** everyone, on free Copilot Chat or the paid licence.

## What to upload

Your meeting notes or the Teams transcript (.docx or .vtt), or paste the notes in.

## What you get

A summary, decisions, an action table (what, who, by when), open questions and a ready-to-send follow-up email.

## Example

Paste your notes from the weekly team meeting. You get five actions with owners and dates - and the agent asks you about the two that had no owner.

## Try saying

- *Here are my meeting notes. What did we agree and who's doing what?*
- *I'll upload a Teams meeting transcript. Can you pull out the decisions and actions?*
- *Can you write the follow-up email from this meeting?*

## Tips

- Check the actions with their owners before you send the email.
- To track actions over time, ask for a message to add them to your Action Tracker.
